blurb: Golden Eagle Boat Charters offers private boat cruises around Stanley Park, Burrard Inlet, English Bay, and False Creek. They cater to private groups for events like birthday parties, corporate events, memorials, and fishing charters. Their vessels are Transport Canada inspected and piloted by ticketed captains familiar with local waters.
extraNote: 30% deposit required to secure booking, refundable if cancelled more than 14 days before charter · Deposit non-refundable if cancelled less than 14 days before charter · Additional hours billed at $645 per hour if arranged before charter, $695 per hour if requested on board · Charter cancelled only under extreme weather conditions deemed unsafe by skipper, full refund or reschedule offered · Late arrivals: charter ends at scheduled time, full price applies; no-shows charged full amount · 750 Pacific Boulevard, Marina Dock ‘A’, Vancouver, BC V6Z 2R8
